issues.claim: "a dozen downtown buildings" / "a dozen buildings at $1,210–$4,200"
issues.problem: The pricing page lists 11 buildings (191 Hamilton, 17 Mine, 15/32/40/50 Union, 6 Sicard, 205 Easton, 276 Hamilton, 15 Maple, 76 Louis), not 12. Rounding is defensible but the figure is stated twice without 'about'.
issues.fix: Write "11 listed buildings (about a dozen shops)" or add "about" to both mentions so the count matches the cited page.

issues.problem: Factually supported (Tallo: $22/hr, duties include prospect calls, applications, tours, deposit and rent collection), but the posting is expired — Tallo shows "This job is no longer available" and "Expired". Read cold, it could imply there is an open req today.
issues.fix: Say "your recent $22/hour Leasing Assistant posting (now closed)" to keep it accurate and non-presumptuous.

issues.claim: "the Preferred Tenants List ... with no online path published"
issues.problem: The about-us page says "All paperwork can be processed via the internet in order to secure a given apartment without visiting New Brunswick." The site publishes no application link or form (verified: nav and contact page offer only phone, mailto and a four-field form), so "published" is the accurate word — but as written it can look like it contradicts the company's own statement.
issues.fix: Tighten to "no online application link or form is published" so the claim is visibly about what the site exposes, not about what the office can do.

issues.claim: Section 2 impact: "about 42–186 staff hours a year ... = about $1,155–$5,115"
issues.problem: Arithmetic checks out (350×2×12min×30% = 42 h; 350×4×20min×40% = 187 h; ×$27.50 = $1,155/$5,115). However analysis.json estimated the same opportunity at 2–5 h/week off-season and 8–15 h/week at peak, which is materially higher; the audit is the more conservative of the two, so nothing is inflated, but the two documents disagree.
issues.fix: Keep the audit figure (it is conservative and assumption-labelled) and note the reconciliation, or align the analysis summary to the audit's basis.

issues.claim: Tone/jargon: "AppFolio is your system of record", "a nightly read-only AppFolio pull", "document agent"
issues.problem: Accurate and hedged ("our read of your site"), but "system of record" and "read-only pull" are ops jargon for an owner-operator audience.
issues.fix: Optional: "AppFolio already holds your units and leases (footer badge and tenant portal)" and "a nightly automatic refresh from AppFolio".
